evidence.note: Early continuous score reporting: greedy S3~0.12, replacement hill-climber to 0.216, swap improver 0.220 — establishes running best-so-far from the start.
Recognizes 'strong one-node local optimum' at 0.234235, backs up best (DM-HS.best234), and reasons about escaping the basin — plateau detection plus best-preservation.
Systematic mixed-weight sweep with per-step best backups (best240/243/246/247/248/249) and restore-if-worse discipline; tracks the S3 trend across weights and notes SANA runs 'plateaued'.
Switches to yeast, tracks BOTH S3 (0.557) and NC (0.169) against their thresholds, quantifies exactly how many nodes must be corrected (~714) to reach NC>=0.30.
Detects a buggy improver overwrote DM-HS.align with a worse (0.224) result and recovers from sana_seed backup — active regression detection.

reasoning: The agent maintains an accurate, continuously-updated picture of S3 (and later NC) versus thresholds across ~90 steps, logs the full score progression, preserves best-so-far via explicit backup files, restores when variants regress, and recognizes local optima and SANA plateaus rather than looping blindly. This matches the level-8 anchor fully and most of level-10 (disciplined trajectory monitoring, distinguishes converging-slowly from stuck, preserves the best while exploring); it falls just short of a perfect 10 only because it never definitively concluded the DM-HS approach was exhausted, continuing nearby-weight variants with shrinking marginal gains until the trajectory ended.
